title: Local creative PDF capability path and bounded Commons DevTools readiness repair
statement: One versioned two-poems capability now validates a committed example, compiles through the existing writer, measures with available local instruments and retrieves verified PDF bytes via CLI and local stdio. Poppler measured the example; PyMuPDF is unavailable. The Commons harness can continue after readiness exhaustion and pass an empty debugger URL; bounded validated polling repairs that path without attributing the CI failure to e assets.
conditions: Unreviewed assistant finding; only a human review accepts it.
Staged inside allowed PDF Lab paths; coordinator must submit to .observstory/proposals/capability-path-20261103.json in an authorized PR.
27 workbench tests pass; one pre-existing synchronous Python availability test skips in this sandbox, with new asynchronous compatibility coverage passing.
No full Commons Chrome smoke, CI rerun, actual ChatGPT/Claude client, native PDF viewer or physical printing was tested.
The CI error is consistent with the harness failure mechanism; exact environmental cause needs original Chrome logs.
Only owned two-poem fixtures are supported; single-process local storage and manual retention, no remote publication or arbitrary PDF upload sandbox.
